title: The Limits of Rank-Dependent Priorities in School Choice
abstract: arXiv:2609.39425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many school choice mechanisms give students higher priority at schools they rank highly and aim to reward students' eagerness. This paper studies whether a centralized mechanism can incorporate such rank-dependent priorities while preserving truthful reporting. I consider a mechanism that jointly specifies how reported preferences modify schools' original priorities and how assignments are determined based on the modified priorities. I require the modification rule to satisfy rank monotonicity and the resulting matching to be stable with respect to the modified priorities. These two requirements jointly capture the policy objective of rewarding eagerness. My main result shows that any mechanism satisfying these requirements as well as strategy-proofness is outcome equivalent to the student-proposing Deferred Acceptance mechanism using the original priorities. translated_title: 学校选择中依赖排名优先权的局限
translated_abstract: 许多学校选择机制会让学生在自己排名较高的学校获得更高的优先权，旨在奖励学生的积极意愿。本文研究了集中化机制能否在保持真实申报的同时纳入这种依赖排名的优先权。我考虑了一类机制，它共同规定了所申报的偏好如何修改学校的原始优先权，以及如何基于修改后的优先权确定分配结果。我要求修改规则满足排名单调性，且由此产生的匹配相对于修改后的优先权是稳定的。这两个要求共同刻画了奖励学生积极意愿的政策目标。我的主要结果表明，任何同时满足这些要求以及防策略性的机制，其结果都等价于使用原始优先权的学生提出型延迟接受机制。因此，如果积极意愿要真正影响分配结果，依赖排名的政策目标就……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了在学校选择问题中，任何满足排名单调性、稳定性以及防策略性的机制，其结果都等价于基于原始优先权的学生提出型延迟接受机制，这意味着依赖排名的优先权无法在不牺牲真实申报的前提下影响分配结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that any school choice mechanism satisfying rank monotonicity, stability, and strategy-proofness is outcome-equivalent to the student-proposing Deferred Acceptance mechanism with original priorities, implying that rank-dependent priorities cannot affect outcomes without sacrificing truthful reporting.
